Start date: 1140-11-07  
Add 40 weeks = 280 days, plus 2 days = 282 days.  
1140 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 1140 mod 100 ≠ 0).  
Days in Nov 1140: 30 days → from 07 Nov: 23 days left in Nov.  
282 − 23 = 259 days left to add.  
Dec 1140: 31 days → 259 − 31 = 228.  
Jan 1141: 31 → 228 − 31 = 197.  
Feb 1141: 28 (1141 not leap) → 197 − 28 = 169.  
Mar: 31 → 169 − 31 = 138.  
Apr: 30 → 138 − 30 = 108.  
May: 31 → 108 − 31 = 77.  
Jun: 30 → 77 − 30 = 47.  
Jul: 31 → 47 − 31 = 16.  
Remaining 16 days into Aug 1141 → Aug 16.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1141-08-16
